name: Prompts and the Queue
description: Powerful prompt creation and prompt queue techniques.

steps.title: The Prompt Box
steps.markdownText: Your AI prompts go here.
commandsBefore: TypeIntoPrompt|I want to build a new feature...|Sim

steps.title: The Send button.
steps.markdownText: Press **Enter** or click this button to send your prompt to Squad.

steps.title: The Queue Tab Strip (part1)
steps.markdownText:
This is the **Prompt Queue**.
If Squad is busy when you send a prompt, it will enter this queue.

steps.title: The Rightmost Tab
steps.markdownText:
The rightmost tab is the **front** of the queue. It sends when Squad finishes its turn.
You can right-click or **drag** tabs to reorder.

steps.title: New Queue Prompt
steps.markdownText:
You can create a **new queued prompt entry** by pressing **Ctrl**+**Q**.
Use this when you need to send a different prompt **before** your current draft.

steps.title: Edit and Pause
steps.markdownText:
To edit a queued prompt, click its tab. 
Processing pauses when the right-most tab is **active**.

steps.title: Queue Nav Shortcuts
steps.markdownText: You can press **Ctrl**+**Tab** and **Ctrl**+**Shift**+**Tab** to navigate among these queued prompts.

steps.title: Edit menu
steps.markdownText: The **Edit** menu includes commands for composing prompts and working with markdown.

steps.title: Selection
steps.markdownText:
This menu works with selections.
Press **Shift**+**F3** to **cycle case** in the selection below.
commandsBefore: SelectPromptText|Let's create a brand new class called the data resource binder.|data resource binder

steps.title: Prompts navigation
steps.markdownText: Jump to past prompts.

name: Setting Up Voice PTT
description: Set up voice dictation and push to talk (PTT).

steps.title: File options.
steps.markdownText: To set up voice, you'll need to bring up the **Options** dialog.

steps.title: Speech Page
steps.markdownText: In the **Voice & Speech** section, we'll set up our speech services provider.

steps.title: Speech Provider
steps.markdownText:
Choose your speech provider. **Azure** is fastest and recommended.
Specify your **API key** and any other needed settings below.

steps.title: PTT Options
steps.markdownText: This page allows you to set your push to talk (PTT) options.

steps.title: Send immediately or confirm before send.
steps.markdownText: These options impact how Push to Talk (PTT) behaves when you **release** the **Ctrl** key.

steps.title: Send immediately.
steps.markdownText:
This first option is the **fastest**. 
Your spoken words are sent immediately when you release the **Ctrl** key.
If you want to **edit** the prompt you must tap **Shift** before you release the **Ctrl** key (to prevent the immediate send).

steps.title: Do Nothing
steps.markdownText:
This second option is the **safest**.
However, you must press **Enter** after dictating to send your prompt.

steps.title: Replacements
steps.markdownText: This page allows you to set up automatic replacements for your spoken words.

steps.title: Click Close.
steps.markdownText: Click **Close** when you're done.

steps.title: Using PTT.
steps.markdownText:
Voice works anywhere text is accepted in SquadDash.
Just double-tap and hold the **Ctrl** key while speaking.

steps.title: Editing with voice.
steps.markdownText: In the selection below you can edit with voice and say "rarely needed".
commandsBefore: SelectPromptText|You can even use a voice for editing an existing prompt. Intelligent insertion replaces text selections based on the surrounding context. So you almost never have to change the case or punctuation after editing with voice.|almost never have

steps.title: The Loop Panel
steps.markdownText:
**The Loop** runs a set of prompts automatically on a schedule or file-watch trigger.

Configure your loop in `loop.md` — the Loop panel shows iteration status and lets you start, stop, or monitor progress.

steps.title: Pausing the Queue
steps.markdownText:
**Pause the queue** to temporarily hold all pending prompts.

This is useful when you want to review the current agent's work before allowing the next queued item to run.

steps.title: The Code Health Panel
steps.markdownText:
**The Code Health panel** runs configured checks against your codebase and reports results.

Use `code-health.md` to define which checks to run. Green = passing, red = action needed.

steps.markdownText: You can use shortcuts to wrap selections inside the prompt text box.
